skills.name: hermes-radicle
skills.description: Use this skill when working with Radicle repositories for peer-to-peer Git collaboration — `rad init`, `rad clone`, patches, issues, node ops, sync, remotes, and session repo detection.

skills.name: hermes-ngit
skills.description: Use this skill when working with Nostr-based Git repositories (ngit / gitworkshop.dev) for decentralized, permissionless code hosting — `ngit init`, `ngit sync`, `ngit send`, `ngit issue`, `ngit pr`, and native `git push`/`git clone` against nostr:// remotes.

skills.name: hermes-model-bench
skills.description: Use this skill when you need to compare multiple LLM models on real prompts rather than specs — run identical queries through each via `hermes chat`, capture outputs, score them on a weighted rubric, and produce a model recommendation or replacement.
